name: Varbase Components
description: Component handler for Varbase: component helpers and a theme switcher for components.
project_description:
Provides a component management system for Varbase and Vartheme BS5 .

 Utilizing Single Directory Components (SDC) and UI Patterns module. Working in hand with Vartheme BS5 the Varbase Theme (Bootstrap 5 - SASS) . The new generation of theming based on Bootstrap 5 , SDC , and UI Patterns .

 Providing a component management system for Varbase and Vartheme BS5 .

 SDC and Storybook Development with Varbase 
 
 Integrate Varbase with Storybook 
 Customize a Varbase Single Directory Components (SDC) In a Custom Theme 
 
 
 
 

 Back to top 

 Use With Varbase Distribution: 
 This module is best used with Varbase distribution.

 Can be installed with any Drupal ~10 or ~11 site. Even if installed with the Minimal or Standard profile.

 However, using it with Varbase gives you way much more cool stuff!
